'''Rona Riggs's mother''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] with [[Corso Riggs's uncle|her husband]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the mother of [[Rona Riggs]] and the aunt of [[Corso Riggs]]. When Corso left home to join the [[Peace Brigade (Cold War)|Peace Brigade]], Rona left home with him. During the [[Separatist War]] on Ord Mantell she and her husband were killed by the Separatist forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rona Riggs's mother is mentioned briefly in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Corso Riggs companion mission.
